source.publication: 2025 IT-140 Personal Income Tax Forms and Instructions (West Virginia Tax Division), with Schedule M bound in
source.section: Schedule M (PDF pp.5-6; instructions PDF pp.28-30), no line applies; IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Single, age 45, wages and a private pension: no Schedule M line applies to either (no line subtracts a private pension). filer born 1980-06-15, age 45 at December 31, 2025. Federal AGI (given) = wages 40,000.00 + private pension 10,000.00 = 50,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 50,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 34,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 50,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M Column A: line 47: age 45, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 0.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 0.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 0.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 50,000.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 50,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 50,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 48,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 15,000.00 = 499.5 + 4.44% x 8,000.00 = 355.2; total 1520.7 = 1,520.70. The Tax Table row 48,000 to under 48,050 (PDF p.38 on) gives 1,522; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 1,520.70.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
